reference: She was tilting the umbrella when the sun moved past noon.
sk: Keď slnko prešlo cez poludnie, nakláňala slnečník.
cz: Když slunce přešlo přes poledne, nakláněla slunečník.
acceptable: She was tilting the {umbrella|parasol|sunshade|beach umbrella} when the sun {went past|passed} noon.
When the sun {moved past|went past|passed} noon, she was tilting the {umbrella|parasol|sunshade|beach umbrella}.

mistakes.text: She tilted the {umbrella|parasol} when the sun moved past noon.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dej, ktorý práve prebiehal, keď sa stalo niečo iné, vyjadruje Past Continuous: „was tilting“, nie „tilted“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Děj, který právě probíhal, když se stalo něco jiného, vyjadřuje Past Continuous: „was tilting“, ne „tilted“.
mistakes.feedback_en: An action in progress when something else happened needs Past Continuous: “was tilting”, not “tilted”.

mistakes.text: She was tilt the {umbrella|parasol} when the sun moved past noon.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „was“ v Past Continuous patrí tvar s -ing: „was tilting“, nie „was tilt“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „was“ v Past Continuous patří tvar s -ing: „was tilting“, ne „was tilt“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “was” in Past Continuous, use the -ing form: “was tilting”, not “was tilt”.

mistakes.text: She tilting the {umbrella|parasol} when the sun moved past noon.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Chýba „was“: Past Continuous sa tvorí „was“ + -ing, teda „was tilting“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Chybí „was“: Past Continuous se tvoří „was“ + -ing, tedy „was tilting“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “was” is missing: Past Continuous is “was” + -ing, so “was tilting”.

mistakes.text: When the sun was moving past noon, she tilted the {umbrella|parasol}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Časy sú prehodené: dlhší prebiehajúci dej je „was tilting“ (Past Continuous), krátky dej „moved“ (Past Simple).
mistakes.feedback_cz: Časy jsou prohozené: delší probíhající děj je „was tilting“ (Past Continuous), krátký děj „moved“ (Past Simple).
mistakes.feedback_en: The tenses are swapped: the longer action is “was tilting” (Past Continuous), the short one “moved” (Past Simple).

source_issues: SK/CZ 'slnečník/slunečník' is a parasol/sunshade; accepted alongside 'umbrella'.
